summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, focused on computer vision and deep learning algorithms optimized for resource-constrained edge platforms. Built and deployed depth estimation, transformer-based vision-language, and object detection models in PyTorch, then optimized them with CUDA kernel engineering, TensorRT, and 8-bit quantization for real-time inference on Jetson-class hardware. Comfortable working across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary, from monocular depth and denoising pipelines to embedded C/C++ deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Designed a custom wavelet bank to suppress low-frequency noise, combined with optimized homography stitching to raise PSNR from 65 to 86 for a metal surface inspection pipeline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free vision-language transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset; trained YOLOv8n achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation.
Exported the trained model to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system with TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) on a Jetson-based edge controller.
Resolved 11 integration failures across the perception-to-actuation pipeline, achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory, achieving ~35% speedup (49.2ms vs 77.5ms baseline) with identical accuracy.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch, including multi-head self-attention, residual connections, and weight tying.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy degradation.

projects.name: COFFIN - Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with a causal Transformer decoder using cross-attention, achieving 15% WER on a Hindi-English dataset.
